name: XV26 Stealth Battlesuits
subtitle: Apr '26 errata · 14 physical loadouts
intro: 1 Shas'vre + 1 MV15 Gun Drone + 1 MV75 Marker Drone + 4 from {Designator, Infiltrator, Liberator, Lodestar, Neutraliser}. Infiltrator is the only repeatable operative. Maximum 2 fusion blasters.
footnotes_html:
Operative rules.
Shas'vre — XV26 Drone Controller (STRATEGIC GAMBIT), For the Greater Good
Designator — Markerlight, Focused Markerlight 1AP
Infiltrator — Covert Protocols
Liberator — Grenadier (frag/krak/smoke/stun, +1 Hit on frag/krak)
Lodestar — Electrochaff Launcher, Homing Beacon
Neutraliser — Multispectrum Sensor Package (SUPPORT), System Jam 1/2AP
MV15 Gun Drone — Photon Grenade Launcher 1AP
MV75 Marker Drone — Markerlight

abilities.name: XV26 Drone Controller
abilities.text: Whenever this operative is in the killzone. Select one friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT DRONE operative in the killzone. Until the end of that operative's next activation, ignore the first two bullet points of its Drone rule (this takes precedence over that rule).

abilities.name: For the Greater Good
abilities.text: Whenever determining the value of Accurate X for the Kauyon faction rule, if this operative is in the killzone, add 1 to the result if 2 or more friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operatives (excluding DRONE) are incapacitated (to a maximum of Accurate 3). Note that you must have a minimum of Accurate 1 to use this rule.

abilities.name: Markerlight
abilities.text: Whenever an enemy operative is a valid target for this operative, or is visible to this operative and within 2" of your Ambush marker (see Prepare Ambush strategy ploy), it's marked. Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative is shooting an operative that's marked, that friendly operative's ranged weapons have the Severe weapon rule. Note that an operative can be a valid target for this operative even if this operative isn't the active operative.

abilities.name: Focused Markerlight
abilities.text:
Select one enemy operative visible to this operative. Once during this turning point, when a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative is shooting that enemy operative, you can use this effect. If you do, improve the Hit stat of that friendly operative's ranged weapons by 1 until the end of that action.

This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.

abilities.name: Covert Protocols
abilities.text: This operative can counteract regardless of its order, but if it has a Conceal order during that counteraction, it cannot perform any actions other than Pick Up Marker, Place Marker or mission actions.

abilities.name: Grenadier
abilities.text: This operative can use frag, krak, smoke and stun grenades (see universal equipment). Doing so doesn't count towards any limited uses you have (i.e. if you also select those grenades from equipment for other operatives). Whenever this operative is using a frag or krak grenade, improve the Hit stat of that weapon by 1.

abilities.name: Electrochaff Launcher
abilities.text:
Once per turning point, when an enemy operative is performing the Shoot action and your opponent selects a valid target (excluding DRONE), you can use this rule, providing this operative isn't within control range of enemy operatives. If you do, until the end of that action, whenever an enemy operative is shooting a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative that's both visible to and within 3" of this operative and more than 2" from that enemy operative:
  • Ignore the Piercing weapon rule.
  • That friendly operative is obscured.

abilities.name: Homing Beacon
abilities.text:
This operative is carrying your Homing Beacon marker. Operatives (excluding DRONE) can perform the Pick Up Marker action on that marker. The first time an enemy operative performs the Pick Up Marker action on your Homing Beacon marker, discard that marker (remove it from the battle).

In the Ready step of each Strategy phase, when you gain CP, if your Homing Beacon marker is in the killzone, roll one D6 if it's more than 6" from your drop zone; roll two D6 instead if it's within your opponent's territory; roll three D6 instead if it's within 6" of your opponent's drop zone. If any result is a 4+, you gain one additional CP.

abilities.name: Multispectrum Sensor Package
abilities.text:
Once per turning point, when an enemy operative within 8" of this operative is activated, you can use this rule. If you do, each friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative within 3" of this operative can immediately do one of the following:
  • Perform a free Dash action (in an order of your choice).
  • Change its order.
Each friendly operative that performs the Dash action cannot end that move within 3" of an enemy operative. Note that a Comms Device from universal equipment only affects the second distance of this rule.

abilities.name: System Jam
abilities.text:
Select one enemy operative visible to this operative. Until the end of that operative's next activation, subtract 1 from its APL stat. Whenever this operative has a Conceal order, you must spend 1 additional AP to perform this action.

This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.

abilities.name: Drone
abilities.text:
• This operative cannot perform any actions other than Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight, Photon Grenade Launcher, Reposition and Shoot.
  • Whenever determining control of an objective marker, treat this operative's APL stat as 1 lower. Note this isn't a change to its APL stat, so any changes are cumulative with this.
  • This operative cannot use any weapons that aren't on its datacard.
  • Whenever determining what's visible to this operative, the round disc at the top of the miniature is its head.
  • This operative is ignored for your opponent's kill/elimination op (when it's incapacitated, and when determining your starting number of operatives). It's also ignored for victory conditions and scoring VPs if either require operatives to 'escape', 'survive' or be incapacitated by enemy operatives.

abilities.name: Photon Grenade Launcher
abilities.text:
Select one enemy operative visible to this operative and roll one D6: on a 3+, until the end of that operative's next activation, subtract 2" from its Move stat.

This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.

  • This operative cannot use any weapons that aren't on its datacard.
